description: This PHP source file provides functions for exporting database recordsets into various formats such as CSV and TSV, either as strings, files, or direct output to stdout. It is part of the ADOdb database abstraction library, focusing on exporting functionalities.

methods.name: rs2csv
methods.description: Converts a recordset to a CSV string.

methods.name: rs2csvfile
methods.description: Exports a recordset to a CSV file.

methods.name: rs2csvout
methods.description: Outputs a recordset as CSV to stdout.

methods.name: rs2tab
methods.description: Converts a recordset to a tab-delimited string.

methods.name: rs2tabfile
methods.description: Exports a recordset to a tab-delimited file.

methods.name: rs2tabout
methods.description: Outputs a recordset as tab-delimited to stdout.

methods.name: _adodb_export
methods.description: Internal function that formats and exports a recordset into a specified delimited format, handling quoting, escaping, and optional output to file or stdout.
